$comment: The story campaign's content (docs/CAMPAIGN.md; the design: docs/CAMPAIGN_GDD.md, the decisions: docs/STORY_CAMPAIGN.md). Sectors and convergence zones as data, by stable id (never rename an id: progress is saved by it). A sector: id, name, classification (historical, modern, future or unclassified), period, description, exactly 3 maps in play order (map: a maps/<id>.json of the suite; unlock: the one character a win on it unlocks), boss (character: the boss's look; companions: the looks fighting beside it), rewards (looks unlocked when the sector is repaired: the boss or companions), expedition (crew: Chrono Crew members the player picks, 8-10; allies: the sector's local allies on the player's side; crew + allies at most 14 a side). A convergence: id, name, description, sectors (its two prerequisite sectors: it stays completely hidden until both are repaired), maps (in play order), rewards. provisional: true marks a placeholder the owner hasn't named or placed yet. Checked by packages/shared/test/campaign.test.ts (references resolve, sizes, ids unique).

sectors.name: The Jade Empire
sectors.description: Temple cities swallowed by the jungle, and a jaguar king who means to keep the sun for himself.

sectors.name: Lockdown
sectors.description: An airport, a ship and an island prison, all closed at once, and a customs agent who lets nobody through.

sectors.name: Neon Tomorrow
sectors.description: Glass towers, neon streets and an orbital station, policed by the time police's own inquisitor.

convergences.name: The Cold Cells
convergences.description: Today's prison and 2032's cryo vault meet across one fault line.
